title: Concurrent Approval: accept at Central Nexus, deliver two neural soma to Node Beta (3,000 cr once)
note: Off, in no plan: a test for one trader, flown once by hand (`route_run.py <pilot> voidborn-concurrent`); nothing is bought (requests.log ENT-014, ENT-020). Substrate Delivery handed its two soma out at the accept (Apollo's reading, 2026-11-15); this run shows whether this mission does too, whether spare soma in the hold count, and where it is handed in. When a run ends with the reward: drop `status`, and every Admiral puts it into its plan.
